# Teacher learning-workspace snapshot

S10 adds the internal, default-off `student-learning-workspace.v1` read model:

```
GET /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-workspace
X-Internal-Token: <dedicated TEACHER_INTERNAL_TOKEN>
```

It is available only with
`STUDENT_LEARNING_WORKSPACE_SNAPSHOT_ENABLED=true`. When disabled, Student
returns `503` with `learning_workspace_disabled` before invoking the use case's
repository reader; no PostgreSQL query or mutation occurs.

The route is mounted only in the dedicated Teacher-token group. The general
`COURSE_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN` is rejected, and enabling the feature without
`TEACHER_INTERNAL_TOKEN` fails configuration validation.

## Response boundary

The response contains `schema`, `context_version`, and an optional
`selected_path`. A selected path contains only its path ID, Course ID,
`ACTIVE` status, path version, and one to 500 position-ordered items with
`reference_type`, `reference_id`, `position`, and status.

Student reads the context, its exact selected `ACTIVE` path, and its items in
one repeatable-read, read-only PostgreSQL transaction. The join is scoped to
the requested student and rejects inconsistent context/path state rather than
substituting another active or primary path.

The projection deliberately excludes Student identity, Course content and
revision, planner rationale/requests, onboarding admission, Teacher/Dialog/AI
identities, targets, evidence, receipts, and all mutations. It carries no
freshness authority for lesson opening. A consumer can choose the first
`IN_PROGRESS` item or otherwise the first `READY` item solely to render a
generic workspace CTA. Browser lesson access and any future progress command
remain separately Student-authorized.

No migration is needed: this slice projects existing selected-context, path,
and item rows only.
